clang17_psp_o32_probe.description: Available host probe only. PSP retail ELF is EABI32; this O32 backend is intentionally NOT accepted for certification.

pspdev_gcc_eabi_probe.description: Open-source PSPDEV GCC EABI probe. Use for compiler fingerprinting only until its version/codegen is proven compatible with the retail game.

gcc303_eabi_probe.description: Template for an FSF GCC 3.0.3 MIPS EABI cross compiler. Name/path is intentionally not bundled; CRI strings make this version worth testing, but they do not prove the game code used it.

pspdev_gcc432_eabi_probe.description: Historical open-source PSPDEV GCC 4.3.2 candidate. The PSP target patch defaults to Allegrex, ISA II and EABI; still diagnostic until exact retail fingerprints are reproduced.

snc_1_2_7503_o2_sched2.description: SN Systems/Sony PSP SNC 1.2.7503.0 fingerprint profile. -O2 -G0 with default/explicit sched=2. Candidate only until multiple nontrivial Kurohyou functions match.

snc_1_2_7503_o2_sched1.description: SN Systems/Sony PSP SNC 1.2.7503.0 alternate scheduler fingerprint profile. Candidate only until multiple nontrivial Kurohyou functions match.

mwccpsp_3_0_1_219_probe.description: Metrowerks C/C++ for MIPS/PSP 3.0.1 build 219 fingerprint profile. Flags are an initial probe only and must be tuned if the family looks promising.

snc_1_2_7503_o2_sched2_debug_g.description: SNC 1.2.7503.0 O2/G0/sched2 with -g. Required by several byte-perfect Block 01 TUs.

snc_1_2_7503_o2_sched2_retpts1.description: SNC 1.2.7503.0 O2/G0/sched2 with retpts1 return-point merging. Required by RecoverField60 exact match.
